sources.label: Patches for Morphe.
sources.author: mitrosoft
patch_list: Changes the package name to com.bloomberg.android.plus.morphe so the app installs next to the Play Store version. Renames custom permissions and provider authorities to match. Makes updating easier as you can get the original APK from Play…

Turns off AppsFlyer (install tracking and event logging) and Comscore (audience measurement). AppsFlyer does not start, and events it logs report success without being sent. Comscore sends no startup, foreground, view, or stream pings.

Disables Firebase and Google Analytics collection flags, Sentry and Facebook SDK collection flags, the ad ID and install referrer permissions, and the Google Analytics, Measurement, and Sentry components in AndroidManifest.xml.
Hides ad components, ad slots, and banner ads, and makes the app report an active device subscription.
Removes the NotoSansJP font files from assets/fonts to save space.
Changes the launcher name shown under the app icon.
Skips Google dynamic ad insertion for on-demand videos and plays the backup stream instead, when the stream provides one. Fixes video streams that do not play.
Removes the selected permission groups from AndroidManifest.xml.
